metadata.title: OSIRIS v5.2.0: Research-to-Evidence Roadmap, Reproducibility Foundation v1.0, and Frontier QPU Validation (Experiments E0–E2, GOV-BENCH-1, SCI-BENCH-1)
metadata.description: Evidence package and clean-room reproducibility foundation for OSIRIS v5.2.0. Contains the formal 180-Day Research-to-Evidence Roadmap, the standardized osiris-benchmarks platform (environment.lock, benchmark_contract.json, run_benchmark.py, verify_results.py), the 1,000-task autonomous code governance benchmark (OSIRIS-GOV-BENCH-1, demonstrating 0.0% critical escapes and 0.0% false rejections), the 100-task scientific falsification benchmark (OSIRIS-SCI-BENCH-1, demonstrating 100.0% defect recall and 0.0% FDR), and the complete Experiment E series frontier QPU datasets on IBM Quantum Heron r2 processors (Certified Bell entanglement in Exp E0, multi-duration stagger response landscape in Exp E1, frozen predictive scheduler and prospective held-out validation across 4 unseen couplers in Exp E2, and pre-registered cross-chip transfer in Exp E3). All code executions and artifacts are anchored by an immutable 14-block SQLite cryptographic authority chain (SYS-021).
